sources.title: counter-geo/c-geo-guard · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: C-GEO Guard is the contrastive chunk-level detector evaluated with Counter-GEO-Bench. This repository contains the one-epoch checkpoint used in the paper, its eight attack-class centroids, the associated calibration metadata, and the original training and evaluation code.

sources.title: Counter-GEO-Bench: Evaluating Defenses Against...
sources.snippet: Safety-taxonomy guardrails target policy violations, while GEO misinformation passes through them as fluent informational content. To this end, a lightweight benchmark baseline, C-GEO Guard, is proposed, reducing ASR by 48\% relative with near-zero utility loss, which proves threat tractable.
